questions.comment: Correct and paper-specific reason to fit shadow velocity; quoted evidence is only a fragment and would be stronger with the sentence quantifying tens-of-percent uncertainty.
Accurately identifies the ±2 mas modeling limit and its implication for resolving small departures; distractors are distinct.
Specific detector cadence and integration consequence are both directly supported; sound methods item.
Correct single-disk mismatch across wavelengths; evidence quote mentions only the long-wavelength half, so extend it to include the short-wavelength mismatch.
The 950±50 K constraint and <900 K failure are correct; current quote supports the threshold but omits the quoted best-fit temperature itself.
Correct combined density-profile and graphite-free far-IR limitation; the quote currently supports the r⁻² profile but not the 60-µm failure, so add that clause.
Correct r⁻¹·⁸ tradeoff; quote identifies the improved 60-µm match but omits the worsened 5–20-µm SED fit.
Correct physical reason for graphite inclusion and a useful contrast with prior models; quote fragment is terse but points to the emissivity mechanism.
The higher historical mass-loss explanation is supported; the quoted fragment is too short to substantiate the alternative's timescale if that detail is intended.
Mass-loss estimates and comparison are accurately stated and the long quote supports all numerical values; appropriately demanding.
Strong causal scale-up limitation item: low oil conductivity, thermal lag, and observed cuvette spread are all directly documented.

The sample-size calculation and >30 conclusion are faithful to the paper; the equation is extraction-garbled in the full text, but the stated rearrangement and prose definition resolve the intended formula.
Specific dispensing rate, per-well number, total, and run time make this a good methods question; distractors are plausible scale confusions.
Correct coefficient-of-variation calculation and reported radii; clearly distinguishable from freezing-temperature dispersion.
Correct ±0.09 °C estimate from droplet radius variation; grounded in the paper's stated relation.
Correctly captures the transfer/static-charge coalescence failure and its consequence for integration.
Correctly contrasts Snomax and INA-free water freezing thresholds under controlled cooling; numerical distractors are credible.
Correct comparison of p-values, standard deviations, and dispersion; quantitatively precise.
Accurately distinguishes improved positional agreement from residual freezing-time variation under linear cooling.
Correct 1,920-droplet cryovial scale and conductive cooling hardware; specific and unambiguous.
CTAB preference is correct; rationale also relies on TX-100 disassembly in base, which is absent from the evidence quote, so extend the quote or narrow the rationale.
Accurate CTAB-specific enhancement near CMC versus no SDS spectral changes; good control comparison.
All optimized reaction conditions and conversion are correct and directly evidenced.
Correct light-source tradeoff: blue light reaches full conversion but takes longer; paper-grounded numerical detail.
Correct role of aerial oxygen and H₂O₂ in photocatalyst regeneration; evidence directly backs the mechanism.
Both the kq and 0.3-ps PET are correct; cited quote contains kq but not the 0.3-ps value, so expand the evidence span.
Correct adduct mass and inhibition of product formation support radical trapping; paper text is truncated immediately after the four-hour phrase, but the stated ~5% is present in the saved full text.
Correct substrate-scope contrast and yields; source extraction is malformed after the halogenated-aniline values, but the figures are explicit.
Correct interpretation of absent p-nitroaniline quenching as absent detectable electron transfer; strong, unique answer.
Correct interfacial co-localization/non-diffusive PET mechanism; appropriate paper-specific synthesis question.
